offers_products.reason: Sells onboard hardware (Galileo, Plane Simple avionics) and software for business aircraft connectivity.

offers_services.reason: Provides air-to-ground and satellite connectivity service plans plus 24/7 support to aircraft operators.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are aircraft owners, operators, charter companies, OEMs and government; not households, though owners may be wealthy individuals.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to fleet and charter companies, dealers, aircraft OEMs, and military/government platforms.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is monthly connectivity service fees, with guaranteed 3-year service plans, over equipment sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Subscriptions on installed aircraft continue; but equipment upgrades could be deferred. Recurring service dominates, so less cyclical.

big_ticket.reason: Majority of revenue is monthly service fees; equipment installs are occasional but service is small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from network, hardware and satellite connectivity technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are business aircraft owners, operators and charter firms, mostly small to mid-sized; government is secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates a North American air-to-ground tower network and needs ongoing investment in networks and satellite capacity.

notes: Customer-size and cyclicality answers are judgment calls based on business aviation owners and operators.
